label: Positive target label and its actual…: A.exist b equals the existing positive b constructor, and…
term: positive target label and its actual existence truth correspondence
definition: A.exist b equals the existing positive b constructor, and at every world v, A.holds v (A.exist b) iff A.ontic.ExistsAt v b. The alignment and target-local two-way correspondence are explicit Prop content, not a hidden subtype or a different Ontic equality.
note: The existing global Arena.Coherent plus this target-label equality yields this condition via targetCoherenceOfCoherent. It does not supply any target truth, modal necessity or actual individual. The proof only needs positive-to-existence at accessible worlds; the frozen input retains the stronger all-world biconditional and no minimality claim is made.
